description:
Ground elevation, slope and the direction the land faces at one address, with how its slope ranks against the rest of its suburb and region.

Coverage: About 16 million addresses in every state and territory. Current to 2026-10-01. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/terrain-property`.

**Price: 3¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: elevation_m, slope_deg, aspect_deg, slope_pctile_suburb, slope_pctile_sa4, resolution_m. Omit for all.

gnaf_id.description: GNAF address id, e.g. `GANSW704074813` (resolve an address with /v1/geocode/address).

name: properties_environment_terrain
title: Terrain at the property
